name: WORLD_CORE_V12_FOUNDATION_REVIEWED_NONPRODUCTION

independent_review.scope: V12 package-scoped pure Core foundation candidate only
independent_review.limit: This is not approval of a V12 product, Gate, hard-dependency path, merge, deployment, or production action.

attached_checks: foundation policy, safe-local environment, repository-secret, Prettier, and git diff checks: PASS

permitted_reuse.scope: Future pure-Core foundation candidates may reuse the V12 typed helpers and the E08-to-downstream read-only boundary.
conditions: Each future candidate must record its own helper traceability mapping and evidence.
Reuse must preserve exact decimal and unit checks, immutable causal references, and the E08 ownership boundary.
Reuse is not authorization to perform an authoritative write, durable application, or product integration.

hard_dependencies.effect: Unchanged. This policy does not approve, satisfy, bypass, or reclassify any dependency.

preserved_boundaries: No V12 product integration, Gate readiness, or dependency-path approval is claimed.
No status/progress or Gate record is changed.
No database, RLS, migration, API, worker, UI, Command, Event, transaction, production, merge, or deployment action is authorized.
ADR-04 remains PROPOSED_NOT_APPROVED; no time or read-order policy is selected.
V09.3 remains the owner of durable atomic commit, idempotency, writer coordination, and recovery evidence.
